library(imputeTS)

# Population

```{r}
pobs = read_excel("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/pob_anual.xlsx")
```
```{r}
pobs_t = t(pobs)
```

```{r}
pobs_t = data.frame(pobs_t)
colnames(pobs_t) = pobs_t[1,1:ncol(pobs_t)]
pobs_t = pobs_t[-c(1, 2, 11, 12, 13), 1:ncol(pobs_t)]
```
```{r}
pobs_t["fecha"] <- c(ymd("2019-06-30"), ymd("2020-06-30"), ymd("2021-06-30"), ymd("2022-06-30"), ymd("2023-06-30"), ymd("2024-06-30"), ymd("2025-06-30"), ymd("2026-06-30"))
```
```{r}
pobs_t
```

```{r}
first_day = ymd("2019-06-30")
last_day = ymd("2026-06-30")
days = seq(first_day, last_day, by = "days")

pob1 <- data.frame("fecha" = days)
```

```{r}
pob <- left_join(pob1, pobs_t, by = "fecha")
```

```{r}
pob
```
```{r}
pob_int <- pob |> 
  select(-fecha) |>  
  apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN = as.numeric)|> 
  apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN = na_interpolation)
```

```{r}
pob_int <- as.data.frame(pob_int)
pob_int
```
```{r}
pob_int["fecha"] = pob["fecha"]
```
```{r}
pob_int
```
```{r}
weeks_date <- seq(first_day, last_day, by = "week")
```

```{r}
pob_filter_weeks <- pob_int %>% 
  filter(fecha %in% weeks_date) %>% 
  select(1:ncol(pob_int))
```

```{r}
pob_filter_weeks <- pob_filter_weeks |> 
  mutate(year = year(fecha)) |> 
  filter(year %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(week1 = isoweek(fecha)) |> 
  mutate(week = paste(year, week1, sep = "-")) |> 
  select(-c(fecha, year, week1))
```

```{r}
pob_filter_weeks
```

```{r}
pob_filter_weeks
```


```{r}
write.csv(pob_filter_weeks, "C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/pob_int_rr.csv")
```

```{r}
pob_pivot = pivot_longer(pob_filter_weeks, cols = -c("week"), names_to = "code", values_to = "pob")
pob_pivot <- pob_pivot |> 
  mutate(week = paste(week, code, sep = "-")) |> 
  select(week, pob)
pob_pivot
```
```{r}
write.csv(pob_pivot, "C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/clean/pob_int.csv")
```
